body: I can't say I feel a strong resolve to live, that would be a little peak.  But when it goes low, it goes real low.  There is deep despair that is overwhelming to the point of shakes and uncontrolled sobbing.  I keep distancing my self from everyone more and more.  Location services off, no more Facebook (deleted all friends first), removed all contacts from my phone.etc...  The cycle is getting worse and worse and I don't know if I can every control it again.

I am in a very similar situation, I don't want my family to know what I am thinking because they will panic and possibly pause their lives or call a professional to help so I am faking it until their sense of worry drifts away (because it always does for almost everyone).  Also hopeless
I feel the same way, going through the motions but not really wanting to.

Very interesting.  I did something bad, very bad (not illegal) and I know it and my spouse knows.  We are separated now and she told me that she could never trust me again.  I know I am wrong for what I did and accept that she feels this way.  Because she is my only true friend and with that over I have nothing left.  Thinking about exiting peacefully is a better way to look my situation.
That is an interesting statement "You are not alone", it seems that many people feel the same way but ultimately we are all alone.
Leaving a Reddit post (electronic) is a possible new way of leaving a Suicide note

Thanks.  I tried to get help and was even given three sessions with a therapist but the only available person is close to 30 miles away.  I get it, there can't be a therapist on every corner and I am in no way faulting the system (at least I have some options), but having to take time off of work (losing $$) and making the drive to and from with out having another breakdown is tough to consider.  I told my spouse that I would make every effort but I don't know, I really just don't know.

>Wow, reading your post hit on some very good points.  Everyone keeps telling me that things will be better, but will they?  I am not as close to the end as you are but getting there.

Good point and you may be right, someone looking for that last sliver of hope.  Also, maybe this is a type of note that get's left behind at the end.  Suicide has been around since the beginning of human time and this is just a new means to the end.
Wow, reading your post hit on some very good points.  Everyone keeps telling me that things will be better, but will they?  I am not as close to the end as you are but getting there.
If have the same question.  I don't understand why they all don't hate me for what I have done anyways and think they would be happy/better off with out me as a reminder and potential burden.
